$note: Screenshot a URL and store the PNG in Directus Files. Mirrors the n8n url-screenshot template. Load it with: DIRECTUS_URL=... DIRECTUS_TOKEN=... node examples/import.mjs url-screenshot.flow.json. Add your key as the POLYDOC_API_KEY env var (or set the operation's API Key).

flow.name: PolyDoc - URL to screenshot
flow.description: Capture a full-page PNG of a URL and save it to Directus Files.
